text: Motion Sick Peon's Soul is an orc ghost located in the Maw of Souls. He provides the Motion Sick Peon's Magical Elixir for free.

Moxie Lockspinner is a gnome thief. In her past, she has "visited" Tol Dagor, Tol Barad and the Stormwind Stockades, and has expressed a desire to see the Boralus bank as well. At the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley, she participated in the town's effort in recovering a long lost treasure from a Second War ship. Moxie has recently been sighted in the Boralus Bank stealing from the tellers and carrying bags from the vault. Additionally, when noticed by another rogue, she paused, raised a silencing finger to her mouth and continued on her thieving. She also appears in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island with Earl-E. She traveled to the Dragon Isles and can be seen tinkering with a locked chest at Wrathio

Munch is a powerful death knight of the Knights of the Ebon Blade. He was set to personally accompany a high-ranking member of the Scourge to Northrend, but was set free following the Battle for Light's Hope Chapel. He helps players defeat during the quest The Air Stands Still, and his ghoul minion fights at his side.
Mudrik Leger is a Dark Iron dwarf located in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City.
Muragus is an orc staff vendor located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. He was briefly seen during the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Murphy Diremoor is a Dark Iron dwarf located in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Murnir Flintbraids is a Dark Iron dwarf located in Shatterstone Harbor in Vol'dun.
My'lanna is a night elf food and drink vendor located in Nighthaven in Moonglade.

Namha Moonwater is a night elf leatherworking trainer in charge of Legendary Leathers within the Magus Commerce Exchange of Dalaran. During the third invasion, she assisted and directed adventuring leatherworkers to invent new leatherworking pieces with the denizens of the Broken Isles. Upon hearing the stories of the night elves in Azsuna, she resolved to leave Dalaran and venture out into the world again.
Nancy Skybrew is a dwarf flight master located at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands.
Naomi is a human child located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Nagtar Wolfsbane is a Mag'har orc hunter located in Dazar'alor. He and his team participate in the Island Expeditions. Spikey is his faithful ravager.
Narygos is a usually calm and open-minded blue dragon of the blue dragonflight.

Nathressa Darkstrider is a night elf rogue found in the Through the Dark Portal set of the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game. She is yet to appear in any of the games. Quotes from her and references to her appear on the following cards: *"Why should I worry about magic? A well-placed kick will stop even the most potent of spells." - Kick
Nasher is an orc flight master located at The Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
Navalar Emberblaze is a blood elf that briefly appeared in the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale during the War of the Thorns.
Nayura is the night elf dockmaster for The Bravery, located at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.

Navarrogg is the leader of the Stonedark tribe, a relatively peaceful tribe of drogbar who never joined the forces of Dargrul the Underking. After an adventurer saves him and his people from the Feltotem tribe, Navarrog pledges his forces to the Highmountain Tribe and assists them in their battles against Dargrul.

Nazlara is a goblin member of the Bilgewater Cartel and a surveyor of the Reliquary found wandering around a small area south of Bonetrail Gulch in Vol'dun, occasionally stopping to look through a spyglass. She carries orders from Arlethal Sunwatcher, and Shandris Feathermoon and an Alliance adventurer kill her in order to obtain the orders.

Necrotic Strike is a Unholy death knight PvP talent. Though this talent is no longer available through the PvP talents interface, it's still granted by Conflict and Strife/Major, the major power of the Conflict and Strife Azerite essence. Equipping Conflict as an Unholy death knight grants both Necrotic Strike and its replacement, Necrotic Wounds. Necrotic Strike won't appear in the spellbook when granted by Conflict; to get it on your bars, you'll need to drag the Major Slot button from the Heart of Azeroth interface's center.
Necrotic Plague is a level 100 death knight talent. For Blood death knights it also causes you to gain 2 Runic Power whenever a target infected with Necrotic Plague attempts to attack you.
Nerus Moonfang is a night elf located at the Sanctum of Light in Eastern Plaguelands.
Nethandril Duskthorn is a void elf located on the Rugged Dragonscale in Stormwind City.

Netherspite is an immense nether dragon found lurking in the Celestial Watch, Medivh's personal observatory. As the only dragon found inside the dark tower, he will use his otherworldly powers to vanquish any creatures that attempt to go near him. This dragon's death is not required for further progress into the tower but he does control the trash between the Shade of Aran and the Chess Event.
Nevo is a human fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. She died after the portal was destroyed.

Newton Burnside is a level 45 human banker located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He can be found in the Stormwind Counting House, the second banker on the right when you enter. He is a member of the Burnside family, who can be found behind the windows on the west side of the bank, opposite the Westmills.
Nez'ra was a demon prince. His horns are powerful artifacts stolen many years ago from Ravenholdt Manor by the Blackrock clan.
Nicole Bartlett is a human who runs the orphanage in the Lower City in Shattrath alongside Orphan Matron Mercy.

Nexus-Prince Bilaal was the leader of the Ethereum forces that attacked the Nexus during the third invasion of the Burning Legion. These ethereals sought to "become void", by using the surge needles left behind by the blue dragonflight in Coldarra in order to widen the breach into the Twisting Nether. Bilaal is first encountered as a projection after interacting with the Ethereal Communication Device in the Azure Dragonshrine. Arcane mages and discipline priests in search of Aluneth and Light's Wrath, respectively, later invade the Beyond in the blue dragons' former capital, the Nexus, in order to stop Bilaal and the Ethereum's forces with the help of the blue dragon Azuregos. By the time th
Nicolas Araujo is a human flight master located at Mariner's Row in Boralus.
Nicanor Ward is a void elf located outside the Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City. He can be found playing with his two dogs.

Nikova Raskol is a human located in Old Town in the city of Stormwind. She walks a circuit along the main oval road. She used to ask Alliance adventurers to avenge her grandson Mac, who was killed by the Defias Brotherhood-inmates of the Stormwind Stockade.

Nimm Codejack is a gnome member of the SI:7 who was tasked by King Varian Wrynn to find the White Pawn in Pandaria. She traveled on the Skyfire from Stormwind City and arrived in the Jade Forest. Nimm and Nodd were later out in a submarine when the Horde attacked Lion's Landing.

Noah Scribeson is a human located just outside Scribes & Nobles in Hook Point in Boralus where he is hosting a booksigning event for his latest release. He can also be seen in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken as he tells a tale about Marcus infront of few Literary Enthusiasts, at the blue dragonflight quarter. His tales even proved too much for a few Overcome Enthusiasts who are all tuckered out. A copy of A Steamy Romance Novel: The Lusty Draconian Mage can be found on a table nearby.
Norgannon () was a member of the titan Pantheon and Keeper of Celestial Magics and Lore.
Noella Davenport is a human flight master located at Grimwatt's Crash in Nazmir.

Oakwidow is a rather sinister one-eyed night elf, who seems to enjoy the torment of others. It is unknown how she acquired the deep scar where her left eye once was, but her further dark machinations are followed in three short stories found in the book Warcraft: The Roleplaying Game. In the first short story, she watches Horde and Alliance members clash with unholy bloodlust in a cursed vale in Kalimdor, until an orc and a human, realized she was watching, and that she might be the one behind the battle, they joined forces against her, but Oakwidow managed to kill the orc with flaming arrows empowered by Elune, and entangle the human in roots before leaving. In the second short story, she t
Numo Spiritbreeze is an orc flight master located at Kor'kron Vanguard in the Dragonblight.
Officer Areyn is a human accessories vendor located outside Champions' Hall in Old Town in Stormwind City.
Officer Van Rossem is a human located at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran. If you've learned Cold Weather Flying he can send you to the Skybreaker.
Ol' Beasley is a human found begging in Old Town in Stormwind City.

Omen is a demon boss summoned in the Moonglade during the Lunar Festival. Blessed by Elune, he was once a noble Wild God, but was corrupted and driven insane by fel energies during the War of the Ancients.

Olivia Burnside is a level 45 human banker located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. She can be found in the Stormwind Counting House, the third banker on the right when you enter. She is a member of the Burnside family, who can be found behind the windows on the west side of the bank, opposite the Westmills.

Ollanus is an orc light armor vendor located in Magar's Cloth Goods in the Drag in Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, he was located in Soran's Leather and Steel Armory in the Valley of Strength and would sell light armor instead of cloth. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Borya.

Olvia is an orc meat vendor located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. After the betrayal of Varimathras and Putress, Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken refugees had to escape to Orgrimmar. During that time Orgrimmar was under martial law and Olvia was complaining about the situation along with other citizens. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, Olvia was seen sleeping in a hut with Horthus and Shan'ti. After the battle of the Broken Shore, she could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. After Vol'jin's death, she was speaking with Shan'ti.
Omakka Wolfbrother is an orc shaman located at the entrance to the Drag from the Valley of Strength, talking with an Orgrimmar Grunt.
Olodam Farhollow is a blood elf located at the Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City.
Olin Umberhide is a tauren Protection warrior that wields a tauren totem. His Alliance counterpart is Qiana Moonshadow.
Omigos was a blue dragon who was killed in a magical accident. His name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Onin MacHammar is a Dark Iron dwarf located in Shadowforge City. Before the Cataclysm, he could be found atop of a tower outside Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh.
Oran Blusterbrew is a Wildhammer dwarf trade goods vendor located at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley.
Ordinn Thunderfist is a Wildhammer dwarf weapon vendor located at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley.

Ordal McLumpkins is a dwarf food and drink vendor located in Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight. He is one of the inhabitants of Wintergarde Village saved by the player during Flight of the Wintergarde Defender; therefore, he can be found at the keep only after the completion of this quest. He's probably related to Fanny McLumpkins.
Osric Strang is a human heavy armor vendor located at Limited Immunity in Old Town, in the human city of Stormwind.

Ormok is an orc rogue trainer located in the Shadowswift Brotherhood in Cleft of Shadow of Orgrimmar. He was briefly seen during the Siege of Orgrimmar. Ormok was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar, initially standing next to Gest.
Orland Schaeffer is a human blacksmithing trainer in Dalaran. He can be seen when the city is above Deadwind Pass, but he is not present in Dalaran above the Broken Isles.

Orux Thrice-Damned is the leader of the Horde forces attacking Maestra's Post. He has the ability to see stealth. During the Fourth War, he led an attack to control the area around Maestra's Post and was, in turn, targeted by the Alliance champions.
Orphan Matron Nanee is an orc orphan matron who has taken a few orphans to visit the Undercity for Hallow's End.
Over-Powered is a Frost death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Frozen Soul (death knight artifact trait) and Ice in Your Veins traits.

Overseer Akrath is an Adherent of Rukhmar and the leader of the Apexis Excavation that accidentally stumbled upon a large ruin filled with Apexis technology. He controls the Apexis turret, using it to carve away chunks of mountain, and to incinerate any Arakkoa Outcasts that try to flee. He has lost a fair bit of pocket change in the cushions of the Overseer's Chair he uses to operate the turret. When adventurers encounter him he has killed two Enslaved Outcasts using the turret and has a third cornered.
Overwhelming Power was a Havoc demon hunter artifact trait. It was linked to the Chaos Vision and Deceiver's Fury traits.

Overseer Felorax is the commander controlling the chaos at Felblaze Ingress‎ in Azsuna. He is cloaked in the shadows and can only be revealed by destroying his warding crystal or using :Spectral Sight.
Paige Felixe is a human found with Erik Felixe near the Ruins of Feathermoon in Feralas. Curiously, she and Erik survived the Cataclysm unscathed.

Pain was the primary resource used by Vengeance demon hunters. Vengeance demon hunters now share the same Fury resource that prior to Shadowlands was exclusive to the Havoc specialization. Pain was required for the execution of most of their damage abilities.
Padawsen is a human located at the Gloaming Reef in Val'sharah. He is being held captive by Humongris, who uses him as a magic wand.

Pantak was a slightly insane wizard in the employ of the Scarlet Crusade. He was the first person to develop the Manacle of Command. He split two manacles apart and poured arcane magic into them. They darkened considerably, turning nearly black. The manacles allowed him to command those who wore the manacles.

Pargath Throatsplitter was an orc and a skilled but quiet warrior from the Bleeding Hollow clan. He was one of the orcs that assisted Teron Gorefiend when he went on an undercover mission to steal the Book of Medivh in Stormwind City. His status remains unknown.

Parsis is a night elf druid who was assigned by Malfurion Stormrage along with Kara'din to work with the Sentinels in Ashenvale, in order to bring the night elf race closer together. Alerted to a disturbance by the forest, he found the dying courier Aradria Cloudflyer and flew her on his back to Darnassus. Malfurion privately considers him capable of becoming an archdruid of high standing someday in the future, when he has gained more experience.
Paola Baldwin is a human gryphon flight master located at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.
Pat is a human child walking with Miss Danna all around Stormwind City.
Patricia Grooverson is a human located outside the Magical Menagerie in Dalaran.

Patrice Lancaster is a human priest trainer located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City. Following the Fourth War, Patrice Lancaster takes care of sending promising priests on missions, more particularly to allow the priest adventurer to obtain unique materials that can only be found in the cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest, as King Anduin Wrynn commissioned the royal enchanter Lucan Cordell to create a special weapon for them, the Staff of the Hallowed, as recognition of their dedication to the Alliance. She also takes care of sending them to fight the enemies of the Alliance in Blackrock Depths, and prevent the influence of the Twilight Hammer over the Dark Iron clan, in order
Pathfinder Jeb is a human located at the ramp leading down to Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City. He is also found at the Wild Coast and Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores.
Paulie is a human located in the back alley area of Old Town in Stormwind City next to a Champion's Treadblade.

Petran is a high elf caster, formerly from Dalaran. He was a friend of Archmage Annan who had given him a knife just three weeks before Archimonde destroyed the magocratic nation. After its destruction Petran traveled to Kalimdor. One day after getting drunk in a bar in Theramore in a bad part of town, he insulted a group of dwarves. They beat him up for the insults, and rifled through his belongings. They planned to steal the knife that he had received from Annan. Afraid for his life, he prepared a spell to attack the dwarves knowing it would likely affect the relations between his people and the dwarves. In the chaos after casting the spell he was able to retrieve the knife and escape into
Philip Luke is a human in Shrine of Seven Stars. He also appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.

Phyrix was a legendary priest who led adventurers through Molten Core and Blackwing Lair. She met an unfortunate demise at the hands of Nefarian, but her spirit still protects Azeroth's champions to this day. She taught many tricks to X'oni, one of the most powerful druids to ever exist.
Poisonmaster Bortusk is an orc located at the Shattered Rise in the Spires of Arak.
Portia Striat is a human flight master located at Rhonin's Shield in the Azure Span. She has connections to Theron's Watch, Cobalt Assembly, Camp Antonidas, and Camp Nowhere, all in the Azure Span.
Pratt McGrubben is a human leatherworking vendor located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. He is a self-described "semi-retired Paladin".
Preda is an orc flight master located at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if she survived the Ironmarch.
Pre-Ignited is a Fire mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Instability of the Tirisgarde and Warmth of the Phoenix traits.
Priestess Lunaspyre is a night elf ghost located in the Tomb of Sargeras. She is part of the Sisters of the Moon encounter.

Prince Farondis is a Highborne night elf and ruler of Azsuna. During the War of the Ancients, Farondis was one the few Highborne rulers who dared defy Queen Azshara, resulting in the destruction of his city Nar'thalas and most of Azsuna at her hands. Ten thousand years later, when the Legion invaded his lands yet again, Queen Azshara herself appeared before Farondis, offering to break her curse should he pledge his people's allegiance to her, but once again, Farondis rejected her, finally impressing and winning back the long-denied favor and support of his people.
Primo is a human located at the T&W Trading Post in Stormwind City.

Prospector Stormpike is a dwarf located in the Library in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. He is a part of the famous Stormpike clan. The prospector is known for his hot temper and the ability to read cryptic texts, such as when he helped the people of Southshore to decrypt a letter from the Argus Wake cult.
Provisioner Fray is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. She later traveled to Stormwind City.

Punra is an orc blacksmithing vendor located in Naros' Armory in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. She can also be seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar. After the battle of the Broken Shore, she could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. After Vol'jin's death, she was speaking with Sana and Naros. Sometimes, she can be seen interacting with an Eager Tourist.
Pul Windcarver is an orc flight master located at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.
Qiana Moonshadow is a night elf Guardian druid. Her Horde counterpart is Olin Umberhide.

Azshara is the queen of the naga, ruling from the underwater city of Nazjatar. Once the ruler of the Kaldorei Empire over ten thousand years ago, she was entrancingly beautiful and beloved by her people. When her Highborne made contact with the Dark Titan Sargeras and his Burning Legion, she accepted his offer to cleanse her world of the impure, of the inferior races. The Highborne and the demons worked together to summon the full might of the Legion and their master on Azeroth through the Well of Eternity, but the Kaldorei Resistance thwarted their efforts. The Well of Eternity was destabilized, and collapsed, swallowing immense swathes of land with it in an event known as the Great Sunderi
Quelama Lightblade is a blood elf wand vendor located on the Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City.

Quentin Bandor is a captain pirate of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Formerly a shrewd, ambitious student of architecture at Stormwind University, Quentin's ship to Lordaeron was commandeered by the Bloodsail Buccaneers. He watched the captain and the ﬁrst mate killed in cold blood, and when the rest of the terriﬁed passengers were dumped on an island west of Stormwind, he asked to join the pirates. They laughed at the student, and he offered to ﬁght the ﬁrst mate for the honor. He slew the buccaneer with little fanfare, his bloodthirsty manner surprising even himself. Two years later, he killed his own captain in his bunk. Now captain of the Sea's Castle, Quentin's ship is the envy of other pira
Quantas Jonespyre is a night elf fruit vendor found at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
Quartermaster Rindelle is a human vendor located at the Shattered Beachhead in Blasted Lands.
Quartermaster Alfin is a human located in Shatterstone Harbor in Vol'dun.
Quartermaster Renick is a human located at the Trade District in Stormwind City during Death Rising.

Rafael Langrom is a human found in Dalaran, inside Langrom's Leather & Links. He sells leather armor, including the Tier 10 armor pieces for druids and rogues. During the purge of Dalaran, he was kneeling on the counter. When Dalaran relocated above Deadwind Pass and the Burning Legion attacked the city, he fought against the demons in the street.

Raesa Morningstar is a Blood elf priest introduced in the third set of the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game. She has yet to appear in any games. Quotes from her and references to her can be found on the following cards: *"Typical magecraft, to conjure a thing of such beauty only to sacrifice it." - Mana Jade
Raethan is a high elf located at the Underbelly in Dalaran. He leads the Underbelly Guard, although he is quite corrupt and expresses some contempt for the city's ruling council.
Raith is a night elf who participates in the Darkmoon Faire dancing contest.

Ramaladni was a warrior of the Brotherhood of the Light and a pupil of Highlord Mograine before the Argent Dawn even existed. When news of Mograine's death reached him, hatred and anger took over. Ramaladni entered Naxxramas to exact vengeance and never returned. Korfax sent adventurers inside Naxxramas in order to learn about Ramaladni's fate. The only evidence they found was his destroyed ring, which Korfax said was made from the very runes that form inside Scourge structures. The ring was eventually fixed and given to its finder. His axe also made its way to the hands of Deathbringer Saurfang, who used the weapon himself and dropped it to his slayers upon death.
Ranah Saberclaw is a Mag'har orc monk located in Dazar'alor. She and her team participate in the Island Expeditions.
Rapid Recovery is a Holy priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Empowered Renew.
Razen Swingblade is a night elf flight master located at the Eye of Azshara.
Raylen Milburn is a human located in Old Town in Stormwind City.

Rebecca Laughlin is a level 25 human tabard vendor and designer located in the Trade District, in Stormwind City. She can be found inside the Stormwind Visitor's Center, which is located beside the exit of the Valley of Heroes into the Trade District. She sells a wide variety of faction tabards, such as those from The Burning Crusade. Many of the tabards she sells, however, require exalted reputation status with the corresponding faction. She is likely related to Aldwin Laughlin. If you decide to create your own guild, she can also help you design a tabard for it. She moves to the Stormwind Harbor during the Battle for the Broken Shore. She was present among the concerned citizens when the V

Archeus is the sword of Morgan Ladimore, a soldier from Darkshire who fought for the Alliance in Lordaeron. After the death of Uther the Lightbringer, he returned to Darkshire to find his wife and two of his three children dead, and subsequently went mad, eventually killing a group of cemetery custodians who came to investigate. Committing suicide, Ladimore returned as the beast Mor'Ladim, haunting the cemetery of Raven Hill until he was destroyed by adventurers working on behalf of Darkshire. Delivering his daughter's ring to his grave outside of Raven Hill, Ladimore's spirit personally gives his sword to those who defeated him, hoping that they would use it as he had once done - in defense
Reckful is a human rogue trainer located in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City.
Reflective Shield is a 4th Tier Discipline priest talent. It causes 22/45% of the damage absorbed by Power Word: Shield on behalf of the casting priest to be reflected back at the attacker.

Archeus is the sword of Morgan Ladimore, a soldier from Darkshire who fought for the Alliance in Lordaeron. After the death of Uther the Lightbringer, he returned to Darkshire to find his wife and two of his three children dead, and subsequently went mad, eventually killing a group of cemetery custodians who came to investigate. Committing suicide, Ladimore returned as the beast Mor'Ladim, haunting the cemetery of Raven Hill until he was destroyed by adventurers working on behalf of Darkshire. Delivering his daughter's ring to his grave outside of Raven Hill, Ladimore's spirit personally gives his sword to those who defeated him, hoping that they would use it as he had once done - in defense
Reekmonger is a large undead dragon flying around above the Necrotic Wake in Bastion.
Rekkul is an orc poison vendor located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. He is found within his shop, Rekkul's Poisons. He was briefly seen during the Siege of Orgrimmar.

Reno Jackson is a human member of the Explorers' League. He can be found on Mechagon Island. He makes an appearance at the Maker's Ascent in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum along with several other members of the league. He traveled to the Dragon Isles and can be found participating in Fight Night in the Dragon's Hoard in Valdrakken.
Renthel was a worgen pack leader mentioned by Gaedrin Moonfang in his Faded Journal.
Ren Arsane is a human located in the Canals in Stormwind City. He is speaking with Saka Kidd and Mai Kota.

Repeat Decree is a conduit for demon hunters. It drops from the following bosses: *Nalthor the Rimebinder in the Necrotic Wake *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthen the Bond.
Researcher Sarix is a high elf flight master located at Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond. She has a Great Riding Rylak and a Riding Gryphon.
Reserved Magician is a human ghost located in the Lost Estate in Stormsong Valley.
Reverse Magic is a demon hunter PvP talent, available at level 30.
Riley Tidy is a human located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. He can be found tinkering a machine while "Lefty" Lucy is sitting besides him.

Roberick Dartfall is the leader of a small force of Forsaken in the Tirisfal Glades. He travels through the glades welcoming visitors and defending anyone who comes into danger. He protects them from the mindless undead and mutant creatures living there. He believes that the Forsaken are different than the Scourge, and they wish it was destroyed. He believes that they have become forsaken by their friends; forgotten or dismissed by the families they once loved and by their former allies. His group works to change that and prove to the world that there are good (not evil) Forsaken. He believes that it is true that many of their kind are jealous of the living, and some have allowed that jealou

Rizzy Ratchwiggle is a goblin pilot located on a small platform hung with Horde banners over Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown. She is linked with the Fringe Science Benefits, she will give you access to fly in a bombardier to complete the quest.

Robby Flay is a human chef located in the Mage Quarter section of the Canal District of the Alliance capital of Stormwind City. Robby is known to be one of the most skilled cooks in the entire kingdom, serving as the Royal Chef for Stormwind's royal family, most notably King Varian Wrynn. Additionally, he offers both training and a chance to help with the preparation of the King's meals to would-be cooks. Robby can be found directly south of the Stormwind Stockade, in a square outside The Scribe of Stormwind and the library of the Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences, standing beside fellow chef, Jon Casper‎.
Robert Rhodes is a human flight master at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn. During the war against the Zandalari, he was poisoned.
Roague is a human fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. He died after the portal was destroyed.
Robert Newhearth is a human found on the second floor of the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. He is the head of the curators in the city and is renowned for his restoration skills.
Rodney Wells is a human flight master located at Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight.

Rokkar was an orc warrior who was Durotan's second in command on Draenor. He was ordered by his chieftain to tie up the Prophet Velen and confiscate the crystals he was carrying, the Heart of Fury and the Brilliant Star. He perished during an attack against a draenei hunting party when the elements refused to assist the orcish attackers.
Rombulus Frostmoon is a night elf located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil.
Roy Pitts is a human located at the Cathedral Square in Stormwind City. He is having a conversation with Jenny Winslow about her fallen cousin and whether King Anduin can defend the kingdom.

Rowa Bloodstrike is an orc located in the Underhold during Stay of Execution. While guarding the imprisoned Baine Bloodhoof, Rowa was confronted by Thrall, Varok Saurfang, Jaina Proudmoore, Mathias Shaw, and an adventurer, who had united together to save Baine from being executed under orders by Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner. She expressed disappointment but not surprise by Saurfang's and Thrall's decision to rescue Baine. Unwilling to stand down, the group was forced to kill Rowa, who with her dying breath claimed that the Alliance would destroy them.
Rubywind Prankster is an air spirit located in Island Expeditions.
Rumpus is a fel orc poison and reagent vendor located at the Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. Rumpus is friendly to players who have completed Blood Oath of the Netherwing.

Rulfo was a young mage of Dalaran who lived an unknown number of years ago. He found items that were believed to date back to the era after the titans ordered Azeroth, and received visions of that time period. The visions eventually drove Rulfo mad, and his mangled body was found dead one day. The reports say he fell off a mountain. Jaina Proudmoore, having read about Rulfo's death, is worried that the same fate shall befall Kalecgos after he found an item once belonging to Tyr and also began receiving visions of early Azeroth.
Runefrost is a Frost death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Ferocity of the Ebon Blade and Runic Chills traits.
Runic Power Mastery is a Death knight talent located in the 1st tier of the Frost Tree.

Rylai Crestfall is a human mage in the Alliance army, originally acting as the guardian of Archmage Overwatch tower during the campaign in Ashran in alternate Draenor. There, she defended the Overwatch and Tremblade's Vanguard from attack, using her Frost magic to hurl bolts of ice down upon invaders in either base. Rylai later served onboard the Skyguard gunship that took part in the battle for the Seething Shore against the Horde, guarding against enemy boarders.
Rye Tele is a human located in the Canals in Stormwind City. He is speaking with Maggie Camp.
Saeld Brightflare is a blood elf battlemaster located in Shattrath's Lower City.

Sadana Bloodfury is an orc shaman of the and the first boss in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds dungeon. She is first seen in conversation with Arnokk the Burner at Shaz'gul, discussing supplies headed for Tanaan Jungle.
Saka Kidd is a human located in the Canals in Stormwind City. He is speaking with Ren Arsane and Mai Kota.
Sal'salabim's Strength is a Brewmaster monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Scalding Brew.
Sana is an orc mail armor vendor located in Naros' Armory in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, she was located in Soran's Leather and Steel Armory.

Sanath Lim-yo is a blood elf located east of Valormok in Azshara. At one point in time, he asked travelers to prove themselves worthy of seeing his master, Archmage Xylem. Since patch 1.7, his master stopped him from charging and now allows anyone to teleport, free of any obligations. He doesn't like the travelers that speak with him and bores easily with many things.

Salle Sunforge is a Wildhammer dwarf general goods vendor located at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley. Although she shares the same last name with Arathel Sunforge, they apparently are not related.

Samuel Wrenchwright was a popular member of the Tinker's Guild in Ratchet. The first tinkers arm was created for him by the Guild, when he lost a limb in an accident. When others saw that Wrenchwright had not only gained a useful limb but also increased strength, they asked the tinkers to develop a version that might be used without the loss of a living arm.
Samuel Clearbook is a human flight master located at Westfall Brigade Encampment in the Grizzly Hills.

Sam is a human child located at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City. Together with his sister and mother, they are watching over the ships leaving for the Broken Isles. He's armed with a stick. After completing the scenario, they appear at Alaina and Cedric's house at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.
Sam Corff is a human located at T&W Trading Post in the Canals in Stormwind City.
Saria Nightwatcher is a night elf warden. A tower in Highmountain is probably named after her: Nightwatcher's Perch.
Saramer Whitewillow is a night elf trade supplier located at Stars' Rest in the Dragonblight.
Sarisse Jume is a human hunter trainer located in the Command Center in Stormwind City.
Savanne is a night elf fishing vendor located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
Say Your Prayers is a Holy priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Serenity Now, Power of the Naaru and Holy Mending (artifact trait) traits.

Scorch is a Fire mage talent. It deals light damage to an enemy and is castable while moving. This ability directly blasts the target rather than throwing a projectile. This means it doesn't have a travel time and, in PvP, doesn't give enemy players any hint what direction it came from.
Sciallax is a demon lord who offered a powerful orb to the night elves of Suramar in exchange for their servitude to the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients.

Scott Westmill is a human banker located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He can be found in the Stormwind Counting House, the second banker on the left when you enter. He is a member of the Westmill family, who can be found behind the windows on the east side of the bank, opposite the Burnsides.
Scott Keenan is a human located at the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.
Scout Valdez is a human located in the Lunarfall's Town Hall. He is also briefly seen in the Twilight Glade in .
Searing Light was a fourth tier priest talent in the holy tree. It increased the damage of the two main holy damaging abilities, Smite and Holy Fire, by a percentage of their normal damages.

Seereth Stonebreak is an orc shaman located at Hunter's Hill in the Southern Barrens. She escaped the area just west of Honor's Stand, near Stonetalon Mountains, when the Alliance began their assault on Honor's Stand.
Seething Power is an Azerite trait available to Havoc demon hunters.

Sentinel Sweetspring is a member of the Sentinel Army and the stable master at Stars' Rest in the Dragonblight. Her saber cat mount and guardian Snowpaw rests behind her. It seems she likes to tease people who are of a serious nature or unaware that she is doing so.
Sentinel Dalia Sunblade is a night elf sentinel located at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Sentinel Moonwing is a night elf warrior trainer located at Lor'danel in Darkshore.

Sensiago Kryl is a human with ebony skin, one good eye and a burn scar on the right side of his head. He is the helmsman of the Inevitable. He suggested to his captain, Malus, that the arakkoa siblings, Ssarbik and Ssavra, should open a portal to have the ship teleported to Gadgetzan. Malus told him that the portals don't work that way. He doesn't trust the arakkoa.
Selina Duskraven is a void elf flight master located at Fort Victory in Nazmir.
Sentinel Eloria is a night elf that would be located in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City prior to the discovery of Pandaria.
Selindra Nightdancer is a night elf located on the Rugged Dragonscale in Stormwind City.
Seoman Griffith is a human leather armor vendor located in Old Town in Stormwind City.
Sergeant Major Clate is a dwarf PvP armor vendor located in the Champions' Hall in Stormwind City.
Sergeant Major Skyshadow is a night elf located in the Champions' Hall in Stormwind City.

Sergeant Carnes is a human located at the Ironforge Brigade Outpost in Silithus. Prior to coming here, he was Corporal Carnes in Ironforge collecting :Iron Bars for the War Effort. Following the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion, as several bodies of the Ironforge Brigade were found in the destroyed Silithus, it is unclear if Carnes managed to escape or perished as well.

Sergeant Hort is a member of the Bilgewater Battalion located in the Shattered Strand of Azshara. He reports that many of the soldiers have feigned injuries to get out of combat duties, and will task players with calling in Airborne Priests to remedy the situation. During the Legion Invasions, he defended the area.
Seriona is a twilight dragon priest featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Seriona is a twilight dragon who seeks to revive the twilight dragonflight.
Sergeant Spiceman is a dwarf located in Shatterstone Harbor in Vol'dun. She trains 7th Legion Riflemen.

Seth is a human child located in the Shattrath Infirmary in Shattrath's Lower City alongside his mother, Zahlia. He is from Lakeshire and compares the Aldor's pace in rebuilding Shattrath to Foreman Oslow's much slower and less successful work on rebuilding the Everstill Bridge. He is friends with some of the children at the Shattrath orphanage.
Shadow Hunter Ju'loa is a jungle troll shadow hunter located in Dazar'alor who is a Darkspear loyalist seeking vengeance for Vol'jin's death through the island expedition Headhunters.
Shadowflame Terrorwalker is a demon located at the Shattrath City‎ in Talador.
Shailiea is a night elf located in the Lion's Rest of Stormwind City.
Shaina Talonheart is a Wildhammer dwarf flight master located at Kirthaven in the Twilight Highlands.

Shaina is a human found at the Forward Command within the Southern Barrens. She is seen walking around the eastern part of the camp, tending to supplies. She tried Sam Trawley's Big Haunch of Stormsnout Meat but was zapped by a bolt of electricity. Her status after the fall of Northwatch Hold and Fort Triumph just prior to the destruction of Theramore Isle is unknown.
Shaka Jivesworn is a high elf located outside the Magical Menagerie in Dalaran.
Shaethis Darkoak was a night elf flight master found at Valor's Rest in Silithus prior to patch 1.8.

Shandris Feathermoon is a legendary night elf Sentinel and the current General of the Sentinel Army, as well as a close personal friend and adoptive daughter of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Shandris first came to prominence during the War of the Ancients, where her entire family was slain by demons, after which she was adopted by High Priestess Tyrande and took up arms herself. After the end of the war, Shandris continued to stand with unwavering devotion by Tyrande's side, becoming a fierce defender of the high priestess. Shandris came to lead a cadre of Sentinels known as the Shadowleaves, and helped lead her people during the Third War, and in the defense of Nordrassil at the Battl

Shan'ti is an orc fruit vendor located between the Valley of Strength and the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, she could be seen sitting with Horthus in a hut. After the failed Battle for Broken Shore, she was seen talking with Horthus. After Vol'jin died, she was speaking with Olvia.

Shang'gok is an orc found in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He reacts to pandaren arriving in Orgrimmar for the first time during Joining the Horde. After the battle for the Broken Shore, he could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. After Vol'jin's cremation, he was speaking with Auctioneer Xifa.
Shardi is an orc flight master located at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.
Shattered Glaive is a common night elf archaeology artifact that requires 35 fragments to solve, and permits use of one keystone.
Shattered Defenses is an Arms warrior major artifact trait. It is linked to the Deathblow (artifact trait) and Exploit the Weakness traits.
Shenthul was a jungle troll rogue trainer and member of the Shattered Hand located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
Shellei Brondir is a human gryphon flight master located in Menethil Harbor in the Alliance-aligned zone of Wetlands.

Shellene is a human located in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City. She can be found inside the orphanage, which is located just south-east of the Cathedral of Light. Along with Orphan Matron Nightingale, she cares for and looks after the orphans in the orphanage, raising them until they are fully grown and ready to venture out on their own.
Shendra is an archmage of the , and member of the . She never much cared for , her dislike turning to loathing when the boy left the Kirin Tor after studying the forbidden magic of the .

Sheilun was the son of the pandaren revolutionary leader Kang. The mogu emperor at the time, Lao-Fe the Slavebinder, favored punishing his pandaren slaves by separating them from their families, sending the children of disfavored pandaren to the Serpent's Spine wall to die as fodder for the mantid swarms, and such was the fate that befell Sheilun. Kang was so grief-stricken over the loss of his cub that he chose to wear all black. However, in a moment of clarity, he realized that the mogu's strength was entirely reliant on slave labor. Soon, he began training other slaves in the martial arts. History does not report if Sheilun died at the Serpent's Spine or if Kang got to see his son again b
Shattering Bolts is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Let It Go and The Storm Rages traits.
Shifting Perspectives is a level 100 priest talent, added in Warlords of Draenor. It is granted to Discipline & Holy priests choosing Power of the Void.
Shiligos was a blue dragon who was killed in a magical accident. His name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Shokavis is an orc inside The Filthy Animal inn located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary within the mage city of Dalaran. He likes throwing axes into nearby dummies.
Sidragos is a blue dragon. He sent orders to Goramosh at the Moonrest Gardens, directing him to move all forces under his command to the Azure Dragonshrine.

Shuja Grimaxe is an orc found on Exile's Reach. Leading an expedition into the island, Shuja and her team were captured by the Darkmaul ogres and their minions. Her mother, Warlord Breka Grimaxe, led another expedition in search of the missing force. She is discovered in Ogre Ruins where Torgok was using her on a necromantic ritual. After Torgok and his undead minions were defeated, Shuja was saved and reunited with her mother. Afterward, she directed the Horde members to rescue her missing party, after which they neutralized the Darkmanul threat and returned to Orgrimmar. She and her mother join up with the Dragonscale Expedition and can be found at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores. Sh

Sigrid Iceborn is a Hyldnir shield-maiden seeking to become a champion of the Lich King and is located at the Savage Ledge in Icecrown. After being defeated in the quest Eliminate the Competition Sigrid flees, but promises to return. She returns later on her proto-drake seeking revenge, in Battle at Valhalas: The Return of Sigrid Iceborn. Despite her strong powers she is killed by the adventurers who beat her before and his/her allies.

Sititing is the non-combat position in which your character crouches or squats on the ground or a chair as opposed to standing. A character cannot engage in combat or use many items or skills directly from a sitting position, they must first stand. Jumping, walking, or running from a sitting position will cause a character to immediately stand and take the appropriate action. Melee attacks against a sitting target automatically hit and cause double damage. The first damage taken while sitting will cause a target to immediately stand. The double damage registers as a critical hit in the combat log, but does not trigger any abilities that would normally trigger in response to achieving a crit.
Skeletal Shattering is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Coagulopathy (artifact trait) and Grim Perseverance traits.
Skrash is an orc flight master located in Plunder Harbor in Tiragarde Sound.
Skittering Broodling is a captured spider demon located on the Fel Hammer in Mardum, the Shattered Abyss.

Sky-Reaver Klum is an orc located at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran. If you've learned Cold Weather Flying he can send you to Orgrim's Hammer. He seems to think the Alliance got what they deserved by rushing into Icecrown, unprepared.
Sky Mage Harlan is a human found next to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Stormwind City when it flew to the Jade Forest on Pandaria.
Sky-Captain Cryoflight is the goblin captain of The Cloudkisser zeppelin that travels between Tirisfal Glades and Howling Fjord.
Skyhunter Donmor'gan is an orc flight master located at Stonefang Outpost in Frostfire Ridge.
Sky-Singer Strag is an orc shaman of the . Gronnstalker Rokash, a former member of the Thunderlords, sends the Horde Commander to kill her and claim her totem in order to prove their strength to him.
Skyguard Amelia is a human flight master located at Fort Wrynn in Talador.
Skyreaver Lyriarra is a blood elf flight master located at the Sunsworn Camp in Talador.
Sky Marshal Sanders is a human flight master located at Vigil Hill in Tiragarde Sound.
Skybound Avenger's Flightwear is the tier 29 demon hunter set.
Sloan McCoy is a human poison vendor located in SI:7 in Old Town in Stormwind City.
Smashum Grabb is a dire orc located at the blood altar east of the destroyed Dark Portal in Tanaan Jungle.
Smashed is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Dark Side of the Moon (monk artifact trait) and Staggering Around traits.
Snarl is a an orc located in the Valley of Honor in the city of Orgrimmar. He is an apprentice of Saru Steelfury. He assists Saru in forging a weapon for the adventurer.

Soignera Strongbow is a night elf found at the Shrine of Seven Stars, standing near Jasso Strongbow. She volunteered to protect the Sapling of Lore. After the defilement of the Vale, she moved before the Shrine.
Sojurn Saka is a human located in Old Town in Stormwind City. He is speaking with Erika Saka.

Somnikus is a green dragon with a tauren visage located in the Ohn'ahran Plains. The treachery of Clan Nokhud led to the death of his son, Solethus. After that loss, he entered a state of mourning and took to guarding the portal to the Emerald Dream located in the Ancient Bough. When Rymek approached the green dragonflight, Somnikus spoke at length with him and found a mutual understanding, even comparing him to Solethus. He placed his trust in the blue dragonkin and allowed him to see the portal with his own eyes. Once Rymek revealed his true form, Somnikus felt great remorse for his role in the Primalists' assault on the Dream. Merithra agreed to a plan that involved a theory conceived by
Sornoth Slagmane is a Dark Iron dwarf flight master located in Mistvine Ledge in Zuldazar.
Soul Warding is a Tier 2 Discipline priest talent. It reduces the cooldown of Power Word: Shield by 1/2 seconds.
Sparkbright is a gnome mage trainer located in the Wizard's Sanctum at the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Southsea Recruit is a human located on Fray Island in the Northern Barrens.

Spirit Tap is a priest shadow talent. It can grant a temporary buff to the priest after killing a target that gives experience or honor, which boosts Spirit by 100% and allows 83% mana regeneration while casting.
Spirit Master Rowena is a human located on the expedition islands.

Spymaster Bloodsnarl is an orc located in Warport Rastari in Zuldazar during the Alliance War Campaign. He was targeted by Shandris Feathermoon who sent the Alliance adventurer, while being under the disguise as a blood troll, to kill the spymaster.
Stagtamer Maliana is a night elf flight master located in Azsuna.

Stanly McCormick is a human inscription vendor located in the Mage Quarter Canal District of human capital of Stormwind City. He is responsible for the sale of supplies for the art of inscription in the shop The Scribe of Stormwind, which can be found south of the Stormwind Stockade on the Mage Quarter's northern face. In addition to normal inscription supplies, Stanly also trades for a wide variety of inks.
Stavril is a human mage. During the Nexus War when Dalaran was attacked by blue dragons, he was telepathically linked to the mage instructors.

Stephen Ryback is a human cooking trainer located in the Pig and Whistle Tavern in the Old Town of Stormwind City. He is apparently well known for the rack of ribs he serves up from a personal recipe.

Stephanie Turner is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. She can be found in the center of the district, standing at a corner just outside a general goods store. She is married to John Turner, who can be found in Ironforge, and together they run the orphanage. She makes the shirts and pants for the children as well as feeds them.

Stefan was the nephew of Captain Renee Lauer and a member of the Scarlet Crusade. He participated in a raid, where Rinn Firecaster and Jillian Grell were murdered by his aunt. He kept questioning his aunt's and the Crusade's motives. Once he was practising with Renee and once again questioned the Crusade's mission. Renee became enraged and overpowered him, but stopped her sword right beside his neck. Her angry expression became a smile and she assured him that their cause is righteous. He managed to rescue his aunt when she had been captured by Barnabas Grell and Reynah Firecaster. Steve Stevenson is a human flight master found in Fort Triumph within the Southern Barrens. His status after the fall of Fort Triumph just prior to the destruction of Theramore Isle is unknown.

Steria Duskgrove is a night elf located in the Upper Frostlands in the Azure Span. She is trying to heal Sylvie the poisoned slyvern, at the annoyance of her Kirin Tor partner Callisto Windsor. Her grandfather was a druid, and despite being a mage herself she intends to wield both arcane and nature magic to make the world a safer place.

Stormspeaker Qian is the apparent leader of the Rajani mogu, located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms' Silent Sanctuary next to Ra-den's throne. He leads the defense of the Vale against the invading mantid, mogu, and forces of the Black Empire. In the aftermath of N'Zoth's awakening, adventurers and Speaker Magni traveled to the Silent Sanctuary to ask for Ra's help with using the Engine of Nalak'sha to power the Forge of Origination, but they found Ra to be despondent and unwilling to help. Qian sent the adventurers to obtain a trophy from one of the generals threatening the Vale in the hopes of convincing the Highkeeper that action should be taken. Stromgarde (or the Kingdom of Stromgarde) is a human nation located on the site of the original capital of Arathor, Strom, in the Arathi Highlands. Stromgarde is all that remains of the mighty human Arathorian Empire. The national color of Stromgarde is red, and its symbols are a closed fist, which is similar to the symbol of the Knights of the Silver Hand, and a bird with its wings spread. During the Second War, Thoras Trollbane, Lord of Stromgarde, joined his kingdom with the Alliance of Lordaeron. The kingdom declined rapidly following the Third War, losing control of much of its territory and capital city, and Thoras being murdered. In the aftermath, his son, Prince Galen Trollbane, was
Strongarm Jarden is a Dark Iron dwarf located in the Grim Guzzler in Shadowforge City.
Summoner Skartax is an orc found in the Deathforge in Shadowmoon Valley. He occasionally summons in Infernal Souls.

Summoner Mepjila was a naga sea witch, a champion of Queen Azshara, and the leader of an army of naga invaders that attacked the temple of the loa Eraka no Kimbul in Vol'dun centuries ago. Kimbul's followers fought bravely, but the loa arrived too late to save them from death. He easily defeated the naga army, but just as his fangs pierced Mepjila's heart, she cursed the spirits of the loa's followers to unending torment, locking them in an eternal battle they could never win. Kimbul took a powerful artifact known as the :Ring of Tides as his trophy from the battle. Hundreds of years later, the Tortaka tribe of tortollans became threatened by the Stormcoil naga and sought refuge with Kimbul.

Supervisor Fizsprocket is a goblin member of the Venture Company and the supervisor of the Venture Co. Mine in Mulgore. The tauren in the area are enraged with his mining division in their delicate land. Tauren Outrunners have already destroyed one of his shipments on its way to the mine, and Morin Cloudstalker asks adventurers to kill Fizsprocket and take his clipboard.
Supply Officer Pestle is a human general goods vendor located at Shatter Point in the Hellfire Peninsula.

Suzanne is a human mage who sits with Janey Anship and Lisan Pierce at the base of the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City, having a discussion about creating a spell or potion. The three sometimes get up to walk along the canals and through the Trade District before returning to their original spot.

Sylendra Gladesong is a night elf leader of the Druids of the Antler in Malorne's Refuge in Val'sharah. During the third invasion, the refuge came under attack by Darkfiend satyrs who stole the Idol of the Wild. She was rescued by Broll Bearmantle and the new Archdruid. She resolved to recover the idol by tracking the satyrs, which brought success. The druids entered Moonclaw Vale and obtained information that led them to Kalazzius the Guileful. She then traveled to the Dreamgrove and became a champion of the order. She was later part of the druids that communed with Malorne beneath Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal. Afterward, she was among the druids that entered and fought in Malorne's Nightmare.

Taela Shatterborne is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, she appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Taelmyr Blazewing is a blood elf flight master located at Theron's Watch in the Azure Span.
Tahko'ki is an orc flight master located in Stormsong Valley.
